title: BC IQ - Update data sensitivities for policy history
summary: Data sensitivities are updated to reflect recent changes to Business Skill policy history, including new fields for archived-by user and text version, and removal of obsolete change log field mappings.
key_points: Business Skill Archived By field classified as Personal data
Business Skill Text Version Skill Text field classified as Company Confidential
Mappings removed for deleted Business Skill Change Log fields
Evaluation data synchronized with upstream change log replacement
Part of follow-up work on Business Skill data structure changes
